scenario_name: 干擾：風向標漂移（感測器故障）+ 葉片角不平衡，陣風、健康機組也有事件

cases.root_cause: 風向標 1 校準漂移（感測器故障）：偏航依偏移的風向追風，風向標 1 讀值看似正常，真實的偏航誤差出現在風向標 2 讀值；偏航誤差造成功率損失與塔架側向負載上升，兩風向標差異超過 15° 時 PLC 跳機（233）。
cases.root_cause_en: Wind vane 1 calibration drift (sensor fault): the turbine yaws to the drifted reading, so vane 1 looks normal while the true misalignment shows on vane 2; the misalignment costs power and raises tower side-side loads, and the PLC trips once the vanes differ by more than 15° (233).

manual_refs.cause: Filtered values (T=25s) of wind vane 1 and wind vane 2 differ by more than 15˚ while 10 min. avg. wind speed > 4.5 m/s
manual_refs.rectification: Check wind vanes. Is one of the vanes bent ?

expected_actions: 檢查兩支風向標（是否彎曲、鬆動、校準偏移）（手冊）
比對兩支風向標讀值找出漂移的一支並重新校準
校準後確認偏航誤差與功率曲線恢復
expected_actions_en: Check both wind vanes (bent, loose, or out of calibration) (manual).
Compare the two vane readings to find the drifting one and recalibrate it.
After calibration, verify the yaw error and power curve recover.

cases.root_cause: 1 號葉片變槳角度校準漂移：三葉片不同步造成 1P 振動與少量功率損失，跳機前沒有任何警報；葉片角度差超過 1° 持續 5 秒時 PLC 以葉片同步差異跳機（335 / 336）。
cases.root_cause_en: Blade 1 pitch-angle calibration drift: the blades lose synchronisation, causing 1P vibration and a small power loss with no alarm before the trip; once the angle difference exceeds 1° for 5 s the PLC trips on blade discrepancy (335 / 336).

manual_refs.cause: The synchronisation between blades 1 and 2 is lost, resulting in unbalance of the rotor (instantly > 8 deg, during 3 sec. > 3 deg or during 5 sec. > 1 deg)
manual_refs.rectification: Are pitch drives 1 and 2 OK ? Check pitch bearing blades 1 and 2 for smooth adjustment. Is greasing OK ? Are there significant differences in current of the blades on screen Zoom/Rotor/Pitch drive inverters ? Is the I2t protection of blade 1 or blade 2 activated frequently ?

manual_refs.cause: The synchronisation between blades 1 and 3 is lost, resulting in unbalance of the rotor. (instantly > 8 deg, during 3 sec. > 3 deg or during 5 sec. > 1 deg)
manual_refs.rectification: Are pitch drives 1 and 3 OK ? Is I2t protection blade 1 active ? Check pitch bearing blades 1 and 3 for smooth adjustment. Is greasing OK ? Are there significant differences in current of the blades on screen Zoom/Rotor/Pitch drive inverters ? Is the I2t protection of blade 1 or blade 3 activated frequently ?

expected_actions: 檢查 1 號葉片變槳驅動與角度量測（編碼器 / 校準）（手冊：pitch drives OK?）
檢查變槳軸承是否卡滯（手冊）
重新校準葉片角度後確認三葉片同步
expected_actions_en: Check the blade 1 pitch drive and angle measurement (encoder / calibration) (manual: are the pitch drives OK?).
Check the pitch bearing for stiffness (manual).
Recalibrate the blade angle and verify all three blades are synchronised.
